h: US Justice Department charges James Comey a third time over alleged decade-old leak
p: The former FBI director faces a fresh charge linked to an alleged leak from about ten years ago, according to reports. It is the third time the Justice Department has brought a case against him.
more: The latest charge is said to relate to the handling of sensitive information.
Comey has previously contested the earlier cases against him.
